title: Video – 130 fentanyl packages drilled out of truck roof rails, Otay Mesa, November 6, 2025

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All video recordings related to the seizure of 130 packages of fentanyl concealed inside the roof rails of a truck at the Otay Mesa Port of Entry on November 6, 2025, as described in CBP's public release. This includes body-worn camera footage, canine team footage, X-ray/scanner imagery, video of officers drilling into the roof rails and removing the packages, and any B-roll or photographs recorded by CBP personnel. I ask that redacted versions be released rather than withholding records in full. Original digital video files are preferred.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mattias Jussila

title: Video – 3,078 lbs methamphetamine seizure, Otay Mesa, April 14, 2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All video recordings related to the seizure of approximately 3,078 pounds of methamphetamine hidden in the front wall of a trailer at the Otay Mesa Commercial Facility on April 14, 2026, as described in CBP's public release. This includes body-worn camera footage, canine team footage, non-intrusive inspection (X-ray/scanner) imagery, and any B-roll or photographs recorded by CBP personnel. I ask that redacted versions be released rather than withholding records in full. Original digital video files are preferred.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Mattias Jussila
